values.note: MWCD's own reservation site or the call center, 1-855-822-6764; book at least 48 hours ahead (a Friday night by Wednesday). Changes and cancellations through the park office. Campers without a reservation are given the list of open lots.

booking.source: https://www.mwcd.org/visit-our-lakes/lodging-facilities/reservations-and-fees/ ('All reservations must be made 48 hours prior'; 'available both online and through the call center 340 days prior') + https://www.mwcd.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/2026-Campground-Rues-FINAL_.pdf ('except for seasonal camping and sites designated as non-reservable'; 'Campers without reservations will be provided with a list of available lots'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Active-duty military 25% off daily camping (subject to availability, free park admission); veterans 10%; seniors 60+ 10%; former POWs and 100% disabled veterans 50% off daily and 30-day camping. Discounts cannot be combined and apply only to the senior or veteran staying on the site.

note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District park on Seneca Lake near Senecaville, south of Cambridge. Nightly camping is in the Parkside, Parkside Central and Woodlands areas; shoreline electric sites run along the north end of Parkside. The Marina Point campground across the bay is seasonal. Beach, marina. --Claude
summary: Hookups 50/W/S, Parkside 300 sites, showers/laundry/spigots, operator booking 340-day window and 48-hour cutoff, some non-reservable, military discount detail confirmed. Stored fees (manual) untouched: engine behind a captcha. Note trimmed. Pin OK. Season not stated.

Local park: the public can book an ordinary night. WATERFRONT lakefront holds: MWCD's Parkside map draws the electric row at the north end on the shore, and it sells Waterfront lots here. Pin 39.9170,-81.4265 sits in that Parkside row, ~200 m from the Parkside centre (~39.9157,-81.4255). Phone 740-685-6013 confirmed.

Park entry fee ('Memorial Day Weekend-Labor Day daily admission: $5 single-occupant vehicle, $10 two or more') is for day visitors: campers with reservations get vehicle passes (2026 rules), so not recorded as a camping fee.
